backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing products, orders, user profiles, and service quote submissions with admin‑protected quote retrieval and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing files, components, and tests supporting public storefront deployment with protected admin routes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend components, pages, hooks, and config files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide covering build checks, public access rules, admin authentication, SPA routing, sharing, and UX validations.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and applying global background and text styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting metadata, root element, and loading the main Vite React app.
frontend/public/404.html: SPA 404 fallback that redirects to root while preserving deep‑link path in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app configuring TanStack Router routes, QueryClient, theming, error boundary, and admin sections.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component displaying fallback UI and allowing page reset or reload.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with contact info, navigation links, social icons, and a dynamic copyright line.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the site header with logo, navigation links, a share button, and a cart button showing item count.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Wraps the page layout with a header, footer, and routed content outlet.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Shows a product card with image, name, description, price, and link to its detail page.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Provides a button to copy the current URL to the clipboard with success and error feedback.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with preset questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Displays customer testimonials with ratings, names, locations, and review text.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Shows trust signal icons and labels highlighting certifications and service assurances.
frontend/src/constants/serviceAreaCopy.t: Exports static text describing the service area.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor instance and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update service quote leads through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Supplies hooks to fetch all orders and update order statuses via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Includes hooks to list, create, update, archive, and restore products using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminUsers.ts: Defines a mutation hook to grant admin permissions to a user by email.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Fetches the caller's user role using the actor for authentication checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity, managing login, stored identity loading, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Defines a mutation hook to place orders via the canister actor and refreshes order queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Provides query hooks for fetching active products and individual product details through the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Creates a mutation hook for submitting service quote requests, invalidating admin quote queries and showing toasts.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus CSS variables for light and dark themes and global element styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Defines admin authentication flow, role checks, and layout navigation for admin pages.
Displays and manages service quote leads, including status updates, notes, and sorting.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Displays all orders with details and allows admins to update order statuses via a select menu.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Provides product management including listing, creating, editing, and archiving products using dialogs and forms.
Allows admins to grant admin permissions to users by email and shows guidance on admin role requirements.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Renders the shopping cart UI with quantity controls, item removal, totals, and navigation to products or checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Implements the checkout form, validation, profile/address construction, and order placement logic.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Displays the homepage hero, service highlights, trust signals, and calls to action for quotes and products.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a confirmation message and order ID after checkout, with navigation back to product browsing.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays product details, handles quantity selection, and adds the product to the cart with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Provides a form for requesting service quotes with validation, submission, and success confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Renders the storefront hero, trust signals, service highlights, and a product list with navigation options.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Implements a persisted Zustand store for cart items with add, remove, update, clear, and total-calculation functions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, colors, typography, container queries, and custom animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, features, and pending requests related to publishing and preserving the app state.
